metadata.description: Claude Code interface mods for pompeitech, in Vesuvius colors

plugins.name: vesuvius-theme
plugins.description: Spinner, tool call rows and end-of-turn line in Vesuvius colors

plugins.name: agent-usage
plugins.description: A live pane showing how many tokens the main conversation and each subagent consumed, each with its pixel mascot

plugins.name: pulcinella
plugins.description: Pulcinella beside a live band of the context window: tokens used, headroom before compaction, turns left, the window by category. He cheers green tests, frets over failures, naps when you're away, and his hat grows with the tokens you spend

plugins.name: maschere
plugins.description: Pick a Commedia dell'arte mask and Claude answers in its voice: Pulcinella ironic, Arlecchino terse, Balanzone thorough

plugins.name: spaccanapoli
plugins.description: A git row above the prompt: branch, ahead/behind, lines changed, the branch's PR, and a warning when you work on main

plugins.name: golfo
plugins.description: Il Golfo: cost and tokens day by day across sessions and projects, with a weekly budget

plugins.name: lazzarone
plugins.description: A system notification when Claude has been waiting on you for a few minutes
